cca_temporal_islands.description: Bilateral anterior and posterior temporal-lobe CCA islands from a thresholded cortical map

default_variant.selection_rule: fixed PE-AV RSA threshold 0.12; retain the two largest qualifying temporal surface components in each hemisphere

surface_ample.expanded_name: activation mapping as a percentage of local excitation
surface_ample.rule: Within each hemisphere, locate two temporal seed islands at the global top 1%, apply the named peak fraction, retain each peak-connected component, reject definitions with raw overlap, then apply a three-neighbour support filter.

excluded_variants.reason: The right-hemisphere peak-connected candidates overlap by 221 vertices before support filtering.

surface_ample.topology_validation: Topo-Omni layer-18 MP therefore begins at 75%. At 75% all four selected families have zero raw overlap and at least 130 vertices in every ROI hemisphere.
surface_ample.lboe_feasibility: All retained 70% and 75% variants permit 100 LBOEs per hemisphere. Some 80% and all 90% families contain a hemisphere with fewer than 102 vertices and will use the documented n_vertices-2 cap.

layer18_top1pct_lboe100.selection_rule: Global top 1% of finite cortical RSA values, followed by the two largest qualifying temporal surface components independently in each hemisphere.
layer18_top1pct_lboe100.cap_check: Every island has at least 118 vertices per hemisphere, so all requested 100-LBOE fits are uncapped.

adaptive_hemisphere_saddle.rule: Within each hemisphere, track the two largest qualifying temporal components at the global seed threshold and lower the strict superlevel threshold until the next included saddle vertex would merge them.

lboe_choice.rationale: Default for future fits; historical requested-200 results remain identified by their lboe200 suffix.

lm_selection.metric: maximum finite rho in the raw group-average RSA searchlight map
lm_selection.selected_reason: Highest maximum rho and clean bilateral temporal seed components at the global top 1%.
